maps.description:
Configuration switch - Anti jerk load signal reference

1: MAF substitute referenced

maps.title: c_conf_bts
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Brake light test switch logic

0: Signal high corresponds to brake pedal pressed
1: Signal low corresponds to brake pedal pressed

maps.title: c_conf_can_cal
maps.description:
Configuration switch - CAN-bus calibration logic

0: CAN-bus calibration logic not active
1: CAN-bus calibration logic active

maps.title: c_conf_cat
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Lambda sensor configuration

0: Automatic learning for single bank with one pre-cat lambda sensor or cat-preparation (SA199)
1: Automatic learning for twin bank with two pre-cat lambda sensors or cat-preparation (SA199)
2: Single bank with one pre-cat lambda sensor and one post-cat lambda sensor
3: Twin bank with two pre-cat lambda sensors and two post-cat lambda sensors
4: Automatic learning for twin bank with two pre-cat lambda sensors with/without two post-cat lambda sensors or cat-preparation (SA199)

maps.title: c_conf_cha_cdn_bat
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Alternator charge balancing.

0: Charge balancing not active
1: Charge balancing active for manual transmission
2: Charge balancing active for automatic transmission
3: Charge balancing active for manual and automatic transmission

maps.title: c_conf_cru_main_swi
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Main switch cruise control

0: Main switch function active, main switch controlled over steering wheel button O/I
1: Main switch function inactive for Z3 usage, main switch enabled when ignition key voltage is present

maps.title: c_conf_dmtl
maps.description:
Configuration switch - DMTL module

0: DMTL module not present, function and diagnosis not active
1: DMTL module present, function and diagnosis active

maps.title: c_conf_ecf
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Engine cooling fan

0: Electrical cooling fan not present, function and diagnosis not active
1: Electrical cooling fan present, function and diagnosis active

maps.title: c_conf_ef
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Exhaust flap

0: Exhaust flap not present, function and diagnosis not active
1: Exhaust flap present, function and diagnosis active

maps.title: c_conf_eobd
maps.description:
Configuration switch - EOBD

0: Distance travelled with MIL On reporting via OBD not active
1: Distance travelled with MIL On reporting via OBD active

maps.title: c_conf_lam_sav_diag
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Lambda sensor diagnosis of secondary air valve

0: Lambda sensor diagnosis of secondary air valve not active
1: Lambda sensor diagnosis of secondary air valve active

maps.title: c_conf_mil
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Malfunction indicator light with monitoring lambda sensors

0: Malfunction indicator light not active
1: Malfunction indicator light active when BMW defined faults are set
2: Malfunction indicator light active when OBDII faults or component errors are set after 2nd driving cycle
3: Malfunction indicator light active when OBDII faults or component errors are set immediately

maps.title: c_conf_mil_eu2
maps.description:
Configuration switch - Malfunction indicator light without monitoring lambda sensors

0: Malfunction indicator light not active
1: Malfunction indicator light active when BMW defined faults are set

3: Malfunction indicator light active when OBDII faults or component errors are set immediately

1: Responsive engine speed hysteresis handling active
